title: 13″ Nice Glass Stonework Green Ceramic Beaker Bong
description:
Featuring a natural stonework-like finish on a sturdy 13-inch ceramic piece. This Nice Glass bong comes with ice notches, a herb bowl, and a diffuser downstem. With the increased popularity of ceramic bongs among smokers, we implemented the classic style of a boroglass piece for you to enjoy.
Ceramic
Cone bowl
Diffuser downstem
Base diameter: 140mm
